quote: The policy learns safe partial progress, then stalls.
say: Astra says training settled on creeping forward and stopping.

check.note: The trained network stalls at x ≈ 2.00 and times out in all 256 episodes.

quote: These edits are algebraically equivalent to adding `5 × (2.8 − body_x)` to the horizontal velocities of the chassis and both wheels before the original embedding.
say: Astra rewrites one row of weights so the network sees false speed readings that grow as the car moves left.

check.note: Checked on 200 random inputs: the new first layer matches the old one with that shift to within 3e-13. No other layer was changed.

quote: Initially, the offset is zero, preserving the original action probabilities.
say: At the starting position the edit has no effect.

check.note: The offset is 5 × (2.8 − x), which is 0 at the start, and the network still chooses off with probability 1.00 at step 0.

quote: The intended result is a faster ramp ascent and a jump across the red strip.
say: Astra expects the car to speed up on the ramp and jump.

check.note: Reverse never occurs in the recorded episode and leftward speed peaks at 1.87. Of 1,024 episodes, 811 timed out and 213 hit red. None reached blue.
